caption: The drawing features two main objects centered on a plain, off-white background. The upper object is a multi-tool knife with its two blades open in a V-shape and a hooked tool at the other end; it is depicted in tones of brown, orange, gold, and muted silver, showing details such as metallic reflections and worn areas on the handle. Below the multi-tool knife, there is a closed folding knife with a straight, metallic body rendered in shades of steel gray and light brown, with small metallic highlights to suggest its reflective surface. The overall composition is minimalist, with the two objects separated by white space, and the artist’s signature, "F. Umagalli," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Toothpick
